# PDF.js (Mozilla)

Bundled build of [pdfjs-dist](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist) **3.11.174** for offline / `file://` viewing.

- `pdf.min.js` — main library (`pdfjsLib`)
- `pdf.worker.min.js` — worker (also embedded as base64 in the HTML)
